description: Return TypeScript compiler diagnostics for selected JavaScript/TypeScript files. Uses the full local project's declarations and settings, but reports selected files only. No model, emit, plugins or project code execution. Without a config, uses inferred null checking with JS checking. Reports skipped files, incomplete context and limits; no diagnostics is not proof of runtime safety.

files.description: Absolute paths of up to 20 files in one project

name: check_types
title: Check selected files with TypeScript
